SQL mein GROUP BY already hai... toh phir Window Function ki zaroorat kyun? Ye sawaal data analyst interviews mein bahut poocha jaata hai!
Ye rahi employees table. A aur B, HR mein. C aur D, IT mein.
Department-wise total salary chahiye? GROUP BY lagao. HR, sattar hazaar. IT, ek lakh das hazaar. Easy!
Lekin interviewer bola: mujhe har employee ka naam bhi chahiye, aur saath mein uske department ka total bhi! Ab GROUP BY fail! Kyunki usne rows ko collapse kar diya.
Yahan entry hoti hai Window Function ki! SUM salary OVER, PARTITION BY department.
Har employee ki row safe, aur saath mein department total! A aur B, sattar hazaar. C aur D, ek lakh das hazaar.
Ek line mein yaad rakho: GROUP BY rows ko collapse karta hai, Window Function nahi! Aise hi concepts ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
